parts.t: Fairview occupies a prime spot on Vancouver's West Side, straddling the slopes between Broadway and the waterfront. With a mix of mid-rise condos and heritage homes, excellent transit along the Broadway Corridor, and proximity to Granville Island, it's a neighbourhood that works for virtually any lifestyle.
